floor_history.headline: Recon: floor 24 -> 23, three scheduling-barrier cheats removed; CSE store-to-load forwarding identified as the single mechanism, volatile axis permanently killed (sandbox strips it).
Floor 23 -> 12: pointer-to-volatile defeats cse dest-recording (cse.c:7329), condition-before-read fills the load-delay slots, three pointer locals reproduce target's three lui/addiu bases — build is

Honest floor 23 -> 18 with three volatile-free structural levers, and s2's blocking volatile question resolved AGAINST the construct (its 12 is discarded) with the sanctioned allowlist path measured d

frontier.hypothesis: The last honest points in the flag blocks are register assignment, and the v0/v1 swap of the SELECTED VALUE is the one sub-problem that is not obviously downstream of the missing reloads.
frontier.mechanism: At floor 18 the conditional value lands in v1 (`ori v1,a0,K` / `move v1,a0`) where the target uses v0 — and the target's v0 is exactly the register `lw v0,0x20(a1)` just used for the condition, so a spelling that shortens the condition's live range or lets the condition and the value share a register class preference may flip it. Blocks 2 and 3 additionally read the byte with `move a0,v1` instead of `lbu` and store via `lui at,%hi` + `sb v1,0(at)`; both of those are downstream of the reload question.
frontier.next_probe: Wave G/H already spent shared condition/value locals, declaration order, s32/u8 on both temporaries, hoisted p[8], ternary / positive-if / read-first (16 numbers, all 18 or worse). Untried: per-block temporaries (val_a/val_b/val_c), an explicit (u8)-cast staging variable for the truncation the `s32 val` form emits, a second natural use of `ptr` late in the function to lengthen its live range, and swapping which of c/val is computed adjacent to the delay slot.
